title: 丝绒小帽
style: soft velvet plush mascot, rich pile fabric, miniature theatrical backdrop
beats: The three yellow tufts fold into a tiny jester cap
An orange pompom swings at its tip
The head bows and the pompom flips forward
The cap springs back with a little wobble
The pompom returns to the cheek
The cap unfolds into the three original tufts
